name: 现场物流计划与执行 - 供应商项目 (4AH)
name_en: Field Logistics Planning and Execution – Supplier Items (4AH)
description_en_html:
Overview

This scope item supports the logistics process for services-related items, such as supplier items and rentals needed for maintenance operations or project-based demand. The process covers the receipt of these items at the supplying base, the logistics to the remote location, and the return process.

Key Process Flow

  • Create maintenance order for remote plant
  • Create EPPM project and project demand for remote plant
  • Create purchase order for remote plant
  • Create data entry for supplier item or rental
  • Receive items at base with a common browser mobile-enabled UI, using QR code scan to receive
  • Print labels
  • Create handling unit
  • Orchestrate warehouse processes
  • Create outbound delivery without reference
  • Initiate return from the remote plant
  • Process returns at base

Business Benefits

  • Identify and track rentals or supplier items
  • Support receiving and processing these items
  • Manage the logistics of rentals or supplier items from a supplying base to a remote location
  • Support the return process of rental and supplier items
description_zh_html:
概览

此范围项目支持服务相关项目的物流流程，例如维护操作或基于项目的需求所需的供应商项目和租赁。该流程涵盖在供应基地接收这些项目、到远程位置的物流以及退货流程。

关键流程流

  • 为远程工厂创建维护订单
  • 为远程工厂创建 EPPM 项目和项目需求
  • 创建远程工厂的采购订单
  • 为供应商项目或租赁创建数据输入
  • 在基地通过启用通用浏览器移动的 UI 接收项目，使用二维码扫描进行接收
  • 打印标签
  • 创建处理单元
  • 协调仓库流程
  • 创建无参考的出库交货
  • 从远程工厂发起退货
  • 在基地处理退货

业务优势

  • 识别和跟踪租赁或供应商项目
  • 支持接收和处理这些项目
  • 管理租赁或供应商项目从供应基地到远程地点的物流。
  • 支持租赁和供应商项目的退货流程
